title: Assault on Banco Totta e Açores, on Avenida da República, in Lisbon, on May 21, 1976
summary: Wikidata item Q117311793, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "robbery carried out by 5 members of the PRP-BR, with 1 536 000$00 being stolen". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
